basics.name: Lucas Guenebaud
basics.label: Senior Data, Cloud & ML Engineer
basics.summary: Senior Data Engineer with more than eight years of experience designing, industrializing and maintaining large-scale cloud-native data platforms within Agile squads. Expert in Python, Spark and SQL, with strong experience in data-lake architecture, large-scale ETL/ELT pipelines and analytics integration. Proven track record of collaborating with data scientists to move predictive models from prototype to production. Advocate for code quality, automated testing and sound engineering practices across AWS, Databricks and modern MLOps.

work.name: Decathlon
highlights: Led migration from legacy pipelines to a cloud-native data platform using AWS, Databricks and Delta Lake, improving throughput and reducing costs.
Designed large-scale Python and Spark ELT pipelines around versioned data contracts, schema enforcement and automated data-quality expectations, improving reliability for downstream data products.
Modernized Databricks lakehouse workloads with Unity Catalog managed tables, liquid clustering and predictive optimization for governed, adaptive data layouts.
Partnered with data scientists to operationalize predictive models and agentic data workflows, including reusable agent skills, agent fleet operations, evaluation, tracing and guardrails.
Embedded GitHub Actions CI/CD, automated testing, observability and governance practices while mentoring engineers across squads.

work.name: Matmut
highlights: Built and optimized big-data pipelines on Cloudera and GCP to serve analytics and machine-learning use cases.
Coordinated with data scientists to deploy models through Vertex AI and DataRobot, orchestrated with Airflow, MLflow and Kubeflow.
Implemented automated tests and monitoring frameworks to ensure continuous data quality and accessibility.
Contributed to data architecture decisions for cross-squad integrations and data-lake enhancements.

work.name: Renault
highlights: Designed an embedded AI copilot architecture for next-generation vehicles and coordinated integration with software and data teams.
Ran Agile delivery for a team of five engineers, managing scope, risks and the technical roadmap.
Established DevOps workflows with Azure DevOps and GitLab, improving build and test reliability.

work.name: Renault
highlights: Implemented data mining on autonomous-vehicle sensor and software data with SQL and Python.
Automated data-quality metrics and anomaly detection using Spark and Kubernetes.
Built internal visualization and reporting tools with Bokeh and automated HTML.

work.name: Renault
highlights: Prototyped autonomous-parking algorithms in simulation with C++, Docker and SCANeR and validated performance at scale.
Applied data science to simulation-generated sensor data for pattern detection and model evaluation.

projects.name: Chevalue
highlights: Developed a predictive model for sport-horse performance using graph attention networks and public genealogical graphs, working with data scientists on features and evaluation.

projects.name: Team Fortress 2 European Champion Team Leader
